rows.guideText: Next, an introduction to Gear 5 Luffy's mechanics
Gear 5 Luffy starts in his normal state
Using skills stacks the "Free Will" effect
When Gear 5 Luffy's allies use a Finisher or Ultimate skill, it also stacks Free Will on Gear 5 Luffy
Keep using allies' Finishers to build up "Free Will" stacks
Once "Free Will" reaches 10 stacks, after an ally uses a Finisher you can immediately use Gear 5 Luffy's Finisher and transform into Thunder Form
In Thunder Form, all allies leave the field and instead give Luffy extra actions and stronger damage
This stage guides you through the ultimate power skill [Bajrang Gun]
To use the Bajrang Gun, first transform into [Thunder Form]. 10 stacks of [Free Will] have been added for you; use the Finisher to transform
After transforming, different skill orders produce different effects. Use the skills in the following order
First use the skill [Gum-Gum Thunder Spread]
Then use the skill [Gum-Gum White Rocket]
Finally use the Ultimate [Gum-Gum Thunder Combo] to enter [Bajrang Gun Ready]
In Bajrang Gun Ready, allies return to the field and can act to build Luffy's [Strike of Freedom] stacks. At 22 stacks, use [Bajrang Gun] to finish the enemy
To let you try it out, this battle grants 22 stacks of [Strike of Freedom] right away. Use [Bajrang Gun] and end it all!

Usopp, how are things in the village?

No matter what, we have to hold this slope
Um... maybe it's just me, but I feel like I heard sounds from somewhere
N-now that you mention it... there's a place just like this to the north!
Did you get the wrong shore?
Hurry! They're about to attack the village! Where is it?
Run straight north from here and you'll get there in 3 minutes

It's the time we agreed with Captain Kuro! Men, trample the village on this island!
The Straw Hat kid is this strong... Nyaban Brothers, it's up to you!

If we keep going like this, we'll see the Marine Base soon!

They say he's like a bloodthirsty beast, a man who takes the heads of wanted pirates and cuts them to pieces. People call him a demon in human skin!
We finally made it to the Marine Base town.
This town was once where pirates bound for the "Grand Line" gathered. You can buy anything you need here.
Okay! I'll gather some gear for the big adventure ahead.
Looks like I can get some good ingredients here. And beautiful women.
There's something I want to buy too.
Oh my, what are you going to pay with? I seem to remember you don't have a penny~

Hey, we haven't decided where to meet up yet... he's hopeless.

Captain of the Krieg Pirates, with inhuman strength. Powered by it, his great war spear easily destroys any enemy in his way, and the MH5 poison gas shells hidden in his shield strike from all sides!

Boss of the Arlong Pirates and a top fighter even among Fish-Men. Ordinary humans don't even get a chance to draw their weapons before him. His sharp teeth and pointed nose are his natural weapons, but you'll only know true fear when he picks up his saw.
A Fish-Man of the Arlong Pirates, a six-sword-style swordsman who swings blades with six arms at once. His ink clouds badly blur the enemy's vision, and his six arms give him excellent blocking.
Princess of the Kingdom of Alubarna. Though raised in luxury, she is a capable fighter who can call on her duck mount for help in battle.
A Baroque Works agent who ate the Bomb-Bomb Fruit. Any part of his body can explode, even flicked boogers and the air he blows out of his mouth.
Former king of the Drum Kingdom, user of the Munch-Munch Fruit. He can swallow anything and remodel it in his body, and can even turn into the weapons he swallows.
A Baroque Works agent. Usually slow, but unusually agile in battle. His amazing arm strength lets him easily swing a 4-ton baseball bat.
A Baroque Works agent and Mr.3's partner, skilled at controlling enemies' emotions with colors. If your damage per turn is too low, better not challenge her.

An East Blue bounty hunter who lives by catching wanted criminals, and followed Zoro after seeing his strength. Fearless in battle, he can call his partner Johnny to unleash a powerful finisher together.
Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Gum-Gum Fruit. His elastic body makes physical attacks weak against him. Deploying characters with elemental damage is the best way to beat him.

Swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates, unstoppable with his Three-Sword Style. Every enemy his blades point at crumbles. A true swordsman, strong in attack and defense with no weakness! There are no tricks to beating him. Face him head-on, man to man!
Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates, who controls the weather freely with her Clima-Tact. When fighting her, keeping an eye on the sky is what matters most.
Sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates, a genius who uses all kinds of ammo to deal different elemental damage and excels at area attacks. Fragile characters are easily killed by his area damage.
Cook of the Straw Hat Pirates, a top-speed kick fighter whose powerful legs can stun any enemy. Front-line fighters with high HP and physical resistance are the best choice against him.

Doctor of the Straw Hat Pirates, a reindeer who ate the Human-Human Fruit. He changes form freely to suit the battle and is an excellent healer. Getting dragged into a war of attrition greatly raises your odds of losing, so a quick victory is key.
Shipwright of the Straw Hat Pirates, a cyborg who only modified his front because he did it himself. Both arms hide powerful weapons, and his Star Shield makes him strong in attack and defense.

Musician of the Straw Hat Pirates, user of the Revive-Revive Fruit. Being nothing but bones makes him amazingly fast. With his unique swordplay, enemies often fall to his blade before they even see him.
Captain of the Buggy Pirates, user of the Chop-Chop Fruit. Anyone hit by his throwing knives suffers Bleed. His signature area attack, the Buggy Ball, also burns and stuns.

Marine Captain and user of the Smoke-Smoke Fruit. A man who hates pirates with a passion, with extremely strong single-target damage skills. Only healers and a strong front line can withstand his attacks!
A Marine swordswoman whose superb swordsmanship belies her cute looks. Her powerful all-target damage skills can easily kill fragile characters.
A Baroque Works agent who ate the Dice-Dice Fruit. He can slash with any part of his body, and his hard body gives him strong defense.
A Baroque Works agent with a man's body and a maiden's heart. He excels at Okama Kenpo kicks, and his swan shoes make his kicks even more destructive.
A Baroque Works agent who ate the Melting Fruit. The wax he makes is harder than steel, and anyone bound by his candle wax is greatly slowed.
A Baroque Works agent who ate the Thorn-Thorn Fruit. She can turn any part of her body into spikes for piercing attacks, and the sharp tips inflict Bleed on any enemy.
Captain of the Bellamy Pirates, user of the Spring Fruit. He can turn any part of his body into springs. His high-speed charge after compressing them easily stuns opponents and deals heavy damage.
A senior World Government CP9 agent who ate the Zoan Cat-Cat Fruit, Model: Leopard. The strongest member in CP9's 800-year history.

One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Sand-Sand Fruit, who controls sand freely and can turn himself into sand. In sand form, Crocodile is highly resistant to physical damage, and his wind-element skills deal tons of damage.
A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Ice-Ice Fruit, with the power to freeze anything. A mighty fighter with no weakness. There are no tricks to beating him; you just have to be stronger!

The world's greatest swordsman. His black blade can cut any enemy to pieces, and sturdy front-line fighters are fragile in Mihawk's eyes. Healers can slow Mihawk's assault; try not to line your characters up in one column.

User of the Rumble-Rumble Fruit who calls himself God. He wields powerful lightning attacks, and ordinary fighters are reduced to charcoal before him. Luffy resists Enel's lightning damage well, and leaving fragile characters out greatly improves your odds of beating him.

A legendary Marine Vice Admiral, the man who drove Pirate King Roger to the brink. No defense holds up against his Haki-clad fists. He's also extremely carefree and may suddenly fall asleep mid-battle, but don't underestimate his strength because of it!

One of the Seven Warlords, user of the Paw Pad Fruit. The paw pads on his palms can knock away anything they touch, and the air bombs he compresses between his palms are devastating, especially against characters standing in a row.
A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Glint-Glint Fruit. The Marines' strongest force, yet very laid-back, he excels at kicks and swordplay. Be ready for a Speed-of-Light Kick before you challenge him!

Second division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates and user of the Flame-Flame Fruit. A powerful fighter who controls fire freely and excels at area attacks, he can easily kill several characters at once.

A Marine HQ Admiral and user of the Magma Fruit. Stern and upright, he upholds Absolute Justice and won't tolerate the slightest trace of "evil". He can turn his body into searing magma with tremendous power; his Great Eruption can instantly evaporate ice dozens of times bigger than a giant.
A CP9 member who ate the Dog-Dog Fruit, Model: Wolf, with a strong body and quick speed. He often shows openings on purpose to lower enemies' guard, then strikes by surprise.

CP9's only female member, cold as an assassin yet a bit of a natural airhead. Her catchphrase is "That's sexual harassment". She ate the Bubble-Bubble Fruit and became a soap woman, weakening any enemy touched by her bubbles.

A CP9 member, a giraffe man who ate the Ox-Ox Fruit, Model: Giraffe. His neck and limbs are hugely destructive; he can wield swords in both hands and still use "Rankyaku". His skill "Amanedachi", unleashed by spinning at high speed on one hand, is extremely destructive!

Archaeologist of the Straw Hat Pirates. A survivor of Ohara, she had a bounty of 10 million on her head at just 8 years old. User of the Flower-Flower Fruit, she can make any part of her body bloom like a flower on anything solid within sight to attack or for other uses.

One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria. A genius surgeon who once saved many patients with miraculous operations and earned the fame and status a doctor deserves. One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria, and commander of the Animal Zombies and Surprise Zombies. A Paramecia user of the Hollow-Hollow Fruit, with the power to instantly crush an enemy's will to fight.

One of the Three Mysterious Men under Warlord Gecko Moria, commander of the Zombie Soldiers and Zombie Generals, and user of the Clear-Clear Fruit. Sea areas: the Great Voyage has several sea areas you can explore freely. Each has its own traits that make exploring harder; warships with a modification level matching the map are recommended.

Warship Energy: warships move freely in sea areas, and moving a certain distance uses energy. When energy runs out the warship can't move; refill it from the warship portrait or at a port. Each warship has its own energy, so you can switch warships to keep sailing. Energy doesn't regenerate on its own.
 
Stamina: used for sea area searches; each search costs some Stamina. Stamina recovers 5 points every 10 minutes, and some ports hand out a little Stamina at set times.
*Sea Area Battles and Searches.
 
Sea Battles: privateers in the sea area will attack you; fight back or retreat. Sinking a privateer gives energy.
 
Sea Searches: there are four types: salvage, diving, fishing and rescue. Search points come in several qualities, each requiring different warship stats; higher quality needs higher stats.

Overview#Guild Sea Battle opens irregularly. In each period, servers that have been open for 30 days unlock it
Once unlocked, players in a guild at Lv40 or above can take part
Guild Sea Battle has three phases: the preview phase, the ranking phase and the match phase
In the ranking phase, guild donations during the event are converted to Heat at 10 to 1 for ranking. The higher the rank, the higher the guild's war zone tier and the better the players' rewards
The match phase lasts several rounds; each round, guilds are matched against opponents in their current war zone;Ranking Phase#The ranking phase lasts 3 days. Each day, guild donations add Heat to the player's guild; once the guild's total Heat reaches set values, its ranking tier rises (10 donation contribution = 1 Heat)
On the last day of the ranking phase, Heat stops being counted and each guild's final ranking tier is settled
Once guild tiers are set, war zones are assigned at the same time
The system groups guilds of the same tier from neighboring servers into one war zone for Guild Sea Battle
After war zones are assigned, Guild Sea Battle officially begins
Each round, guilds are matched against opponents in the same war zone;Match Phase - Schedule#The match phase has 4 rounds, each lasting 7 days
Each round goes as follows:
Monday: the system matches each guild with an opponent
Monday-Saturday: all guild members can deploy multiple teams to the routes
Saturday-Sunday: guild members can no longer deploy, edit or delete teams; the leader and vice leaders can plan strategy and adjust each team's route
Sunday daytime: both sides' teams are finally locked (character data stops updating), awaiting the decisive battle
Sunday evening: the decisive battle officially begins!;Match Phase - Battle#Each route's battle is decided by 1 match with forced auto-battle. If the turn limit is reached, the side with more surviving characters wins; if equal, the side that dealt more damage wins
After a team wins in a row, its stats decay somewhat each time it enters battle: the longer the streak, the greater the decay
The winning team can go on to challenge the enemy's next team. If on a route we defeat all enemy teams, or the enemy deployed none, we win that route
If neither side deployed teams on a route, the system randomly picks one guild to win it
When all route battles are over, the side that won more routes wins the round;Rewards#Round rewards: after each round, round rewards are mailed to all guild members who fought, based on the guild's war zone and the round result
Settlement rewards: after all matches, season rewards are mailed to all guild members who fought, based on the guild's war zone and total wins
Ranking rewards: after all matches, special rewards are given based on the personal damage ranking and personal teams-defeated ranking
Mode currency in the rewards can be exchanged at the Guild Sea Battle Shop
The Guild Sea Battle Shop closes when the season ends, and this season's mode currency expires then, so mind the exchange deadline;

1. The flow is as follows:

Start: contestable outposts begin neutral; uncontested outposts around the home port begin captured

Thank you so much. The Marines have raised your bounties, so be careful!
You bastard, someday I'm going to kill you!
That villa next door is so magnificent. When will I ever get to live in a fancy house like that?
Ask the herb merchant if they want to go into business with me.
I'll pass on doing business. I just want to look after my herb field.
If he won't come, I'll go myself!
Um, don't be scared, I mean no harm. Could you tell everyone in the village that I have no hostility toward humans?
He really said that? Hmm... but I worry a Fish-Man's nature won't change. Let's keep an eye on him.
I see. I'll work hard to show everyone.
I've been feeling uneasy lately, like something's about to happen. Could you ask the others for me?
Tell him not to worry. With us Marines here, everything's fine.
Even so... I still can't stop worrying.
I feel like someone's been watching me lately. Could you help me find out if there's someone like that?
I'm the one watching him. If you don't tell him, I'll tell you a big secret.
No one? ...Thank you. Was it just my imagination?
Hey! I'm going to be a bounty hunter! I know the villager at the entrance is really strong, so go ask him to teach me to fight!
How did he know? Fine, tell him I'll come find him.
Hey! I'm going to be a bounty hunter! Go tell the weapon merchant to get a weapon ready for me!
Hey! I'm going to be a bounty hunter! Getting stronger means I could get hurt anytime! Tell the doctor to be ready for me!
That kid, huh... sigh... got it.
The villagers were all beaten up and I can't treat them all alone. Please find someone to help me.
I know a little medicine. Let me get ready.
I'm so glad you found someone to help.
The organization sent a new batch of weapons. Please tell the person handing them out.
What! How could an outsider know about this? Well, thanks anyway.
Ah! I slipped... you mustn't tell anyone!
There was an accident and I don't know where I am. Oh, could you check whether any of my crewmates are here too?
What, the stranded pirate is here too! I'm so glad I'm not alone!
Knowing I'm not alone is such a relief.
We reached this unknown island, but I lost my weapon. Could you ask my crewmate if he has a spare one?
What is he thinking? Of course I lost my weapon too.
What do I do now! I'm panicking!
We were shipwrecked while the Marines were chasing us. If we made it to this island, then the Marines... please go check if there are any Marines nearby!
Being shipwrecked while chasing pirates was really unlucky.
We lost most of our gear in the shipwreck, so could you please notify the Marines in Loguetown?
Some of our people were shipwrecked? I'll arrange a rescue right away.
When I first came here, there wasn't a soul on this island. I never thought it would get so lively. Please go say hi to the Marines for me.
There's an explorer here too. Looks like this isn't some nameless deserted island after all.
This herb field next to me was cleared by my great-grandfather, though it was much bigger back then.
Could you please bring me some fertilizer?
Thank you, I'll take good care of this herb field!
The Fish-Men have been taken away, but not everyone hurt back then has been treated yet. Could you gather some herbs for me?
That's enough for now, but I may need your help again later.
Guarding the town takes strength, and training my men takes realistic battles. Can I count on you?
We lost, huh. That shows us the gap in strength!
After facing the pirates, everyone has gained a lot of combat experience. Can I ask you for a mock battle?
Lost again, huh. That shows us the gap in strength!
So everyone has spare clothes to wear, please collect some clothing in the field for me.
Back then, that pirate crew came to town and took a lot of valuables.
All we can do now is search the field. Go defeat 5 Bald Pirates and see if we can get the valuables back.
Looks like nothing turned up. What a shame.
A customer over there thinks being a pirate means he can eat without paying. Teach him a lesson for us.
Our restaurant has never been afraid of pirate trouble.
More pirates came up the back deck to make trouble. Go drive them off.
The Fish-Men are gone, but failing to protect this place shows we weren't strong enough!
Can I ask you for a mock battle? Don't hold back!
Lost again, huh. That shows us the gap in strength!
After Arlong was taken away, I want to live in peace with the villagers, but the Fish-Men in the field will try to stop me. Please scare them off for me; we believe in different things.
Guarding Loguetown takes strength, and training my men takes realistic battles. Can I count on you?
Lost again, huh. That shows us the gap in strength!
We've had reports of a large group of pirates in the Arlong Park field. Could you please deal with them?
Hey, don't you watch where you're going? You almost ran into me. So, how are you going to pay me back?
Huh? Don't want to pay? Then I'll teach you a lesson.
Heh heh heh, we didn't know you were so strong. Please forgive us small fry.
Pirates keep causing trouble at the execution platform lately. Please teach them a lesson!
The execution platform symbolizes the Marines' authority. Pirates won't be allowed to damage it.
Since Fish-Man Pirates appeared in the Cocoyasi Village field, the supply of their local fish has dropped sharply. Could you drive off some Fish-Man Pirates?
Please go defeat some pirates, so people are less likely to get hurt.
Even stranded, we can't let our fighting get rusty. Can I ask you for a mock battle?
I never thought I'd end up on this island too. Some pirates nearby are forcing me to be their ship's doctor. Teach them a lesson for me; I serve everyone.
Thank you. If you need treatment here, come find me anytime.
There are lots of bounty hunters around here. If I made them all my men, I'd be a real power when I leave, right?
Hmm... none of them want to follow me. What do I do?
So we can get out after all!
Finally, it's our turn to take the stage.
I'm going to live! Live! I'll make it back alive! Back to Alubarna!
Calm down, I'm here to save you.
Ah, sorry, I just wanted to ask. I'm not trying to catch you; I just want to become a bounty hunter.
Do you think I'd make a good bounty hunter?
You think being a bounty hunter is dangerous work? Could you find me a weapon?
I know bounty hunting is dangerous, facing all kinds of pirates every day, but it's my dream.
There are bounty hunters all over Whiskey Peak, but they're not why I want to become one.
I came to this town when I was 10, and by then I'd already decided my path.
My hometown is a small town in the East Blue. Back then I lived a carefree life and worked at a blacksmith's. If you don't believe me, ask the blacksmith in Loguetown.
You mean that kid from back then? Yes, he worked under me as a helper, and I'm the one who sent him to the Grand Line.
Before I left that town, a band of mountain bandits came, and the town's peace was shattered.
They charged into the village, looted supplies everywhere and burned down quite a few houses. That kid couldn't stand it and went after the bandits.
You heard it from the blacksmith? Back then I charged at them and the bandits knocked me flat. I couldn't fight back at all.
But then two bounty hunters rushed out, stopped the bandits and saved me. They called themselves agents of justice.
Those two were easily beaten, but they said the words that made me become a bounty hunter: "There are times when people fight for what they believe in."
Then a really strong three-sword bounty hunter showed up.
They beat the bandits and saved the village. After that, I made up my mind to become a bounty hunter.
So I asked the blacksmith to take me to the Grand Line. Just you wait, I'll definitely become a bounty hunter of justice!
We're sorry for drawing our swords on you before and causing you trouble.
We had our reasons for doing that.
Whiskey Peak was originally a town famous for its hospitality and fine liquor.
I used to be a pirate too, and I stayed here because I loved this town.
For most pirates who've just entered the Grand Line, this is their first stop.
They stay here a few days to let their Log Pose record, then head for the next island.
While the pirates stay, everyone throws feasts together and drinks Whiskey Peak's fine liquor.
Once the pirates are dead drunk, everyone in the village springs into action.
We capture all the pirates and claim their bounties.
All of this is on orders from a mysterious organization, and some of its officers are here.
We're no match for them, so we have no choice but to follow their orders.
They treat everyone in the village well and haven't changed our way of life, so everyone joined that mysterious organization.
Baroque Works: that's the organization's name. Even though we joined, we know very little about it.
To make amends, let us give you some fine liquor. It's stored in those cargo crates over there.
Sorry, even the stock has been drunk dry. This is all that's left.
Hey, what do you do? Interested in joining us at Baroque Works?
What do I do? I'll tell you a secret: I'm a bounty hunter Baroque Works just sent to Whiskey Peak. You look strong; how about joining us?
Oh? Interested? Then bring me something to eat and I'll tell you all about it.
That's better. Listen closely: Baroque Works is a seriously impressive outfit.
Hmm... I should test you first before you join; otherwise it's too casual.
You're amazing! You beat them so fast!
Tch, I thought you'd die out there. (whispers)
If you're this strong, why join Baroque Works through me?
I need to go ask the boss upstairs, or... I kind of want to taste Whiskey Peak's fine liquor.
So you chose to join Baroque Works because I'm so handsome and dashing! Since you're so honest, I've got no reason to doubt you.
The core of Baroque Works is its senior agents, whose code names combine "Mr." with a number.
Each of them is paired with a partner to carry out missions together. The closer the code name is to 0, the stronger they are.
I've been with Baroque Works a long time. I was originally over in Alubarna.
Ugh, it makes me mad just thinking about it. Fight me so I can blow off steam.
Shouldn't you go a little easy on me? Some intel just came in for me. Hold on.
W-wait, you look a lot like the photo in my intel.
You're on Baroque Works' hit list. Since we've talked so much, I won't tell them. Run, quick.
Who are you? I don't know you. Don't talk to me.
Go, quick. Take this, and don't let them catch you. (whispers)
When I grow up, I want to be a hero of the country!
If you want anything, just come to me.
Play It Safe and Find the Merchant
I'll take you all down together!
Have you heard the legend going around lately?
They say that treasure can make a person incredibly powerful.
I heard the legend from someone else. He hasn't been well lately, so you'd better bring him some herbs.
Thanks for the herbs. What did you come to see me about?
You want to know about that legend? I know very little myself; I only heard it's related to treasure.
I heard the legend from a friend in Syrup Village. If you want to know more, he's the one to ask.
What are you doing here? I'm busy. If you want to talk, go pick up some seashells for me first.
Okay, what do you want? What? The legend? Where did you hear about it? No, I don't know anything.
Well? Did you learn the details of the legend?
He clearly didn't believe you. Take my letter; then he'll definitely tell you.
Ah, so he sent you to me.
It's a true legend, but only the strong can pursue it.
If you really want the truth of this legend, make your way to Loguetown.
I heard the legend from an old man in Loguetown: whoever gets the legendary treasure becomes incredibly powerful.
...You've been walking back and forth in this village for a while now, haven't you.
Do you want to know this village's history, from before that Fish-Man came?
Before that Fish-Man came to the village, everyone was happy.
That little girl back then was always talking about her dream of drawing a map of the whole world.
But one day, everyone's nightmare arrived.
That Fish-Man came to these islands.
At first, everyone wanted to rise up and fight back.
But the gap in strength was too great. We had no choice but to pay the money that Fish-Man demanded.
That little girl's family was struggling then. She lived with her sister and their adoptive mother.
Then that Fish-Man found their family, and tragedy struck.
Because they couldn't pay enough, the little girl's adoptive mother was killed by that Fish-Man.
That Fish-Man also discovered the little girl's talent for surveying and took her away.
The little girl made a decision for everyone in the village.
She decided to join the pirate crew and made the 100 million promise.
You know the rest, don't you.
I can tell that little girl from back then can smile for real now, with you.
The pirates have been driven off, so we've come back to the village.
To ease the burden on the mayor who took back the village, we decided to rebuild our homes together. The pirates got rid of all our tools, so go to the blacksmith first.
You've come to help rebuild the town? Then please go find some ore in the field first.
With this ore, I can make the tools everyone needs.
Please deliver these tools to the villagers so we can rebuild the town together.
Thank you. With these, everyone can get to work!
The hunter seems to be looking for help in the field.
Did they send you to help?
It's great that someone came to help. I'm preparing lumber for everyone, but I can't gather it all alone.
It's great that someone came to help. I'm preparing lumber for everyone, but I can't gather it all alone.
Here are some lunchboxes. Please hand them out; everyone's working hard on the rebuild.
Thank you for all your help. Please accept this small token of thanks.
The hunter sent an urgent message. Something urgent seems to have come up.
You're here. I just found out something important!
The last pirates were driven off, but we found more pirates in the field. Defeat them and find out what they're up to.
What! They want to take over the village again! Hurry and warn the villagers!
Why did you rush back in such a hurry? What did the hunter find?
This time we'll arm ourselves and never let them take our town so easily again! Go get some weapons from the weapon merchant!
Please tell the hunter we're ready to defend ourselves!
The villagers are really determined. We should try to stop the attack; we can't let everyone in the village take such a big risk.
They must be about to give up on attacking. Just a little more.
The pirate captain is over there! Defeating him will surely end this danger!
Great, the town is safe now. Thank you so much; please accept this token of thanks.
Lately I always hear the cooks whispering when I come to the restaurant. I'm a little curious what they're talking about.
Go ask the cooks what they're talking about.
Since you're interested, I'll tell you: we're talking about every cook's dream, the "ALL BLUE"
We got so caught up talking that customers ordered again. Help us catch some fish.

Legend has it the "ALL BLUE" is a sea with every kind of fish from all four seas of the world. If you believe the head chef, it may be on the Grand Line. And the Grand Line is full of countless pirates in the way.
That's why we're still in the East Blue.
Never mind the legends. Our East Blue has fantastic ingredients too.
But we haven't found those rare ingredients in a long time.
The "ALL BLUE" may only exist in legend, but it's on everyone's mind.
So the cooks were talking about their dreams. I hope they get to chase them.
You've come to see this execution platform, haven't you.
Do you know why this execution platform is so famous? It's the story of the Pirate King.
I've lived here for decades and seen so much.
I witnessed the birth and death of the Pirate King with my own eyes.
The Pirate King's journey began right here in Loguetown.
He set out from here, crossed the Red Line and searched the Grand Line for "ONE PIECE".
It's a mysterious sea that no one had ever conquered.
He succeeded. He beat everyone and found "ONE PIECE".
But after he found "ONE PIECE", the most baffling news came out.
He was suddenly captured by the Marines. Some rumors say a Marine hero caught him.
I still clearly remember that day, when he smiled on the execution platform and said those words.
Those words sent countless pirates flocking to the Grand Line.
You must have heard them too.
"My treasure? If you want it, you can have it! Go find it! I left everything I own in that place!"
And so Loguetown became what it is now: the East Blue's last stop before the Grand Line.
You were drawn here by the Pirate King too, weren't you? The Grand Line is right before you. Go seek the world's treasure!
We're sorry for drawing our swords on you before and causing you trouble.
We had our reasons for doing that
Whiskey Peak was originally a town famous for its hospitality and fine liquor.
I used to be a pirate too, and I stayed here because I loved this town.
For most pirates who've just entered the Grand Line, this is their first stop.
They stay here a few days to let their Log Pose record, then head for the next island.
While the pirates stay, everyone throws feasts together and drinks Whiskey Peak's fine liquor.
Once the pirates are dead drunk, everyone in the village springs into action.
We capture all the pirates and claim their bounties.
All of this is on orders from a mysterious organization, and some of its officers are here.
We're no match for them, so we have no choice but to follow their orders.
They treat everyone in the village well and haven't changed our way of life, so everyone joined that mysterious organization.
I don't dare say the name of that organization. Even though we joined, we know very little about it.
To make amends, let us give you some fine liquor. It's stored in those cargo crates over there.
Sorry, even the stock has been drunk dry. This is all that's left.
For some reason, today feels really different.
Everyone in the village seems down. Is it because that guy left?
Without hearing that guy's lies today, I forgot to eat breakfast. He came on time every single day.
No one's used to life without that guy.
A villager told us what that guy did to protect the village. We'd wronged him before.
Now everyone is truly grateful to that guy.
That guy is gone, so we have to protect the young miss in his place. Please bring back a weapon.
Great! With this weapon, we're confident we can protect the young miss!
The weapon's here, so let's give it a try.
Ouch, I haven't moved in so long that I just pulled my back. Could you gather some herbs for me?
Hey hey hey, did you just arrive on this island too? I got lost at sea and drifted here, and it looks like the bounty hunters chasing me ended up here too. Can you stop them for me?
Did you see that?! While you were gone, a dinosaur walked by! It was as tall as a 10-story building!
This island is terrifying. How could anyone stand up to dinosaurs that huge? I have to escape fast. Help me gather some lumber.
G-giants? You say you ran into giants?
Could it be that the environment and creatures here are still in prehistoric times?
Be careful at every turn here.
I think I've seen that person over there. He might know more about this island; go ask him.
Hello. The pirates over there may have seen me on other islands. Wherever there's adventure, there I am.
Want to know how this island came to be? Then help me find some things.
Thank you. It would've taken me ages on my own.
Little Garden got its name because of two giants.
This is the giants' little garden.

Great! This will definitely get us up to the sky!
This is the sea! Not just a water spout, it's a sea current shooting into the sky!
And the wind blowing up from below is an updraft from geothermal heat and steam explosions on the seafloor.
If it's wind and sea we're up against, I can sail us through!
Who do you think this ship's navigator is?!
Who are you, a pirate? I haven't seen your face before.
Since you've come to Mock Town, take a walk around. If you see our boss, say hi for me.
I haven't seen him in a long time. I wonder how he's doing.
Found it, it's the Going Merry.
With strength this pathetic, you dare go around killing people? Come with me!#1,9
Stop talking tough and come quietly, and spare yourself the pain!#1,9
Go any further and you'll leave Loguetown. You'd better behave!#1,14
#1,8Let me go and we'll fight another three hundred rounds!
I'm tired! I need a rest!#1,8
Enough talk, keep walking! Once I hand you to the Marines, I've got other things to do!#1,14
You'd better let me escort you to prison quietly and spare yourself the pain!
Listen up! I'm the ruler of the seas with ten thousand men and a hundred great ships. Just wait for your end!
You're so weak. Don't ever let me run into you again, or today's ending will repeat itself!
Behave yourself, or you'll taste bitter fruit. Any one of my crew could crush you!
Idiots, what are you yelling about!
Faced with Admiral "Aokiji" suddenly showing killing intent, a flustered Robin strikes first...
This big ship is mine now!
